subject: Inn
text: Staying at the inn in Rimildar costs 55 Gold.

evidence.quote:
Rimildar
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Located just south of the swamp cave.  It has a Weapon Shop, but it
does not have a tool shop. This is where you will buy keys. You half to walk
around the edge of the north side of the town to reach the key shop.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Inn: 55 Gold

subject: Axe Knight
text: Walking on the small swamp space with a tree next to it at the eastern end of Hauksness makes an Axe Knight appear.

evidence.quote:
At the eatern end of the town. you will find a small
swap with a tree next to it. If you walk on that space, an Axe Knight will
appear.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Searching the ground after defeating the Axe Knight in Hauksness reveals Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote:
If you can defeat the Axe Knight, and then search the ground, you will
find Erdrick's Armor.

subject: Golem
text: Golem must be defeated before you can enter Cantlin.

evidence.quote: You must defeat Golem before you can enter.

subject: Cantlin shop
text: A key is required to access the shop selling the Flame Sword and Silver Shield in Cantlin.

evidence.quote:
You will need a key to get to the shop with the
Flame Sword and Silver Shield.
